description: Composition policy for L-system / recursive branching structures — trees, branches, wiring harnesses, river networks, lightning, neurons. Pattern: trunk or main path (primary_volume tagged 'trunk') + recursive child branch nodes (attached_to parent, ratio-scaled by depth) + leaf/terminal decoration. Expansions add branch nodes when the brief declares depth/branching_factor and add leaf nodes at the recursion terminals. The policy lives under the hard_surface domain registration today because vegetation domain extension lands in Cycle 6; once that extension ships, this policy moves to vegetation_or_branching domain.
